verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a payments and commerce platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on merchant data. The evidence, however, only describes infrastructure that lets external AI agents discover products, check out and pay. The MCP server lets users query Adyen in natural language through their own external LLM client, which is not in-product insight or suggestion generation. Nothing in the pack shows AI-generated insights or recommendations drawn from the user's data inside the product.
